subtitle: Cross-reading of August 24, 2026: Polymarket price from the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC), presidential book at USD 132.34M, against the BTG/Nexus poll released this Monday, fieldwork Aug 21 to 23, which is the first new national poll since Aug 21. Both instruments moved in the same direction on the same day: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 1.80pp in price and the poll measured the runoff at 46% to 45%.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 62.50% (vol USD 8.92M accumulated), the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC). Unchanged on the day.
fortes: BTG/Nexus on Aug 24 (n=2,006, fieldwork Aug 21 to 23, reliability 4, BR-09028/2026) places him at 41% in the first round without Pablo Marçal, 40% in the scenario with him, and ahead in the runoff by 46% to 45%. He leads both scenarios.
In price he remains well ahead: 62.50% against 35.05%, a distance of 27.45pp, with his contract accumulating USD 8.92M inside a presidential book of USD 132.34M.
His price did not move on a day when the second-placed candidate rose 1.80pp. The entire compression of the gap came from the other side, not from a loss of his own.
In the first-round runner-up contract he appears with 5.95%, which is consistent with a market that sees him finishing first.
His floor since Apr 14, when the series begins, is 34.50%, measured on Apr 25. Today's price sits 28.00pp above that floor.
fracos: ⛔ No upside superlative applies: his highest reading since Apr 14 is 67.50%, from Aug 16, and today's price is 5.00pp below it.

🔴 The distance to second place fell to 27.45pp, the narrowest since Jun 21 on the daily-close criterion. And the narrowing is not unprecedented: on May 5 the distance was actually NEGATIVE by 7.80pp, with the opponent ahead.

⚠️ In the BTG/Nexus wave he appears as the MOST REJECTED candidate, at 49% against 48% for the second-placed one, according to Poder360. Leading on voting intention and on rejection at the same time is the uncomfortable finding of the poll.
The evaluation of the administration in the same wave is 48% approval against 49% disapproval, and 43% rate the administration poor or terrible against 35% excellent or good.

He did not take part in the first presidential debate, on Aug 23 at 8 PM on Band, arguing that the format would not give balanced conditions to respond, according to Gazeta do Povo. The debate had the smallest number of participants in studio since 1989, according to Poder360.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 62.50% (vol USD 8.92M accumulated), the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC), unchanged on the day. The distance to the second-placed candidate fell to 27.45pp, against 29.25pp in yesterday's reading, and it is the narrowest since Jun 21 on the daily-close criterion. The entire compression came from the other side: he stood still and the opponent rose 1.80pp. His highest reading since Apr 14, when the series begins, is 67.50%, from Aug 16, so today's price sits 5.00pp below his own maximum. The BTG/Nexus poll released this Monday is the first new national poll since Aug 21 and keeps him ahead in both first-round scenarios, with the runoff at 46% to 45%. In that same poll he is the most rejected, at 49%.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 35.05% (vol USD 8.84M accumulated), the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC). Up 1.80pp, his highest value since May 13.
fortes: ⭐ LARGEST GAIN OF THE DAY IN THE PRESIDENTIAL BOOK: 35.05%, up 1.80pp. It is his highest value since May 13, checked point by point against the 341 records of the series since Apr 14.
BTG/Nexus on Aug 24 measures the runoff at 46% to 45%, inside the 2pp margin. In the scenario without Pablo Marçal he has 37% in the first round, against 36% in the same house's Aug 17 wave.
The distance to the leader fell from 29.25pp to 27.45pp in a single day, and he produced the entire drop.
In the first-round runner-up contract he pays 85.50%, which remains the steadiest reading in the book.
Veritá on Aug 21 is still the only national poll in the window that has him winning the runoff, at 47.3% against 42%.
fracos: ⛔ His series peak is 45.50%, from May 6, so today's price sits 10.45pp below his own maximum. A daily gain is not a series superlative.

⚠️ The 1-point runoff gap in BTG/Nexus is NOT a new low: the same house had already measured 46 to 45 on Aug 3. The tracker's runoff series reads 4 points on Jul 27, 1 on Aug 3, 3 on Aug 10, 3 on Aug 17 and 1 now.
His 1-point gain in the same house's first round, from 36% to 37%, fits entirely within the 2pp margin and does not constitute a measured movement.
He also skipped the Aug 23 debate, having conditioned his presence on his opponent attending, according to Gazeta do Povo.

🏛️ On Aug 23 justice Flávio Dino reaffirmed the nullity of parliamentary amendments designated by party leaders, citing suspicions about the conduct of his party's president, and set a deadline of five business days under a daily fine of R$ 100 thousand, according to Poder360 and CNN Brasil.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 35.05% (vol USD 8.84M accumulated), the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC), up 1.80pp, the largest gain in the presidential book on the day. It is his highest value since May 13, and the series peak remains 45.50%, from May 6. On the same day BTG/Nexus measured the runoff at 46% to 45%, and the two instruments moved in the same direction. ⚠️ The caveat the series imposes: that 1 point TIES what the same house measured on Aug 3, so it is a repeated level and not a new low. In the first round he went from 36% to 37% against the Aug 17 wave, a movement within the margin.

📌 The divergence over third place widened: at the ballot box he has 3% against 5% for Caiado, and in the third-place contract the price puts him 15.00pp AHEAD. The two instruments disagree on who is third.

The high accumulated volume coexists with a price under three points: volume measures how much money has passed since the contract opened, not today's probability.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 2.90% (vol USD 10.94M accumulated), the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC), down 0.55pp. The BTG/Nexus poll released this Monday places him at 3%, his lowest value in the 30-day window, against 4% in the same house's Aug 17 wave. cruzamento:
The day has movement, and it comes from one side only. Lula ended at 62.50% with no change at all and Flávio Bolsonaro rose 1.80pp to 35.05%, so the distance between the two fell from 29.25pp to 27.45pp. The entire compression came from the second-placed gain, not from a loss by the leader. The presidential book totals USD 132.34M.

The 35.05% is the second-placed candidate's highest value since May 13, checked point by point against the 341 records of the series since Apr 14, and the 27.45pp is the narrowest distance between the two since Jun 21 on the daily-close criterion. ⚠️ Narrowing, however, is nothing new in this series: on May 5 the distance was actually NEGATIVE by 7.80pp, with the second-placed candidate ahead of the leader.

⭐ THE CROSS-READING OF THE DAY IS ONE OF CONVERGENCE, AND THAT IS WHAT IS UNUSUAL HERE. The BTG/Nexus poll released at 6:36 AM this Monday, fieldwork Aug 21 to 23, n=2,006, registration BR-09028/2026, measures the runoff at 46% to 45%, and the price moved in the same direction on the same day. The panel records the coincidence of direction and does not perform the subtraction: probability of winning and voting intention are different quantities, and 35.05% and 45% are not comparable by difference.

🔴 THE CAVEAT THE POLL'S OWN SERIES IMPOSES: the 1-point runoff distance is NOT the narrowest the house has ever measured, it is a TIE. The tracker's runoff series reads 4 points on Jul 27, 1 on Aug 3, 3 on Aug 10, 3 on Aug 17 and 1 now. The first round tells the same story: today's 41% to 37% repeats exactly the 41% to 37% of Aug 3. Anyone comparing only with the Aug 17 wave reads an unprecedented tightening that the series does not confirm.

🕐 AND THE POLL DOES NOT MEASURE THE DEBATE: fieldwork closed on Aug 23 and the first presidential debate was at 8 PM that same day, on Band, without the top two and with Romeu Zema withdrawing at 12:01 PM. Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos and Augusto Cury attended. Any reading that ties the poll result to the debate falls outside the fieldwork window.

🏛️ On the institutional front, two dated facts. On Aug 21 the president of the São Paulo electoral court rejected the special appeals of Pablo Marçal's defence AND of the electoral prosecution service, keeping him ineligible until 2032, and the coverage only circulated on Aug 24. And on Aug 23 justice Flávio Dino reaffirmed the nullity of parliamentary amendments designated by party leaders, with a five-business-day deadline and a daily fine of R$ 100 thousand. The contract on the impeachment of a Supreme Court justice did not move on either and remains at 3.35%.
